dialect_varying_payloads.reason: OpenInference records an LLM span's whole request envelope in input.value (messages plus model, tool definitions and invocation parameters) and the whole provider response in output.value; OTel GenAI records the normalized conversation in gen_ai.input.messages / gen_ai.output.messages. One strictly contains the other plus more, so neither is a re-encoding of the other and SPEC.md 3.3 constrains neither (FIXTURES.md 4.4). Narrowed to what the first cross-dialect run actually showed disagreeing: `value` on every llm/agent payload, and `mime` on the AGENT span alone, where OpenInference reports text/plain for a bare string against this dialect's message array. The TOOL payloads are NOT declared -- mime and value both agree there, which is the byte-for-byte agreement the two captured traces show, and it stays a tested claim.
